findings.title: Negative integer quantity is persisted with a successful response and negative totals
findings.expected: Negative quantities must return 400 and leave the cart unchanged, per CART-2.
findings.actual: Source trace: PUT quantity -1 passes the exact-int and upper-stock checks, stores -1, computes totalItems -1 and totalPrice -12, and reaches the HTTP 200 response. This was not runtime-observed.
findings.impact: The authenticated caller can persist an invalid negative quantity in their existing cart; calculated item count and price become negative. No downstream checkout impact was tested or claimed.

risks.reason: Existing tests cover only quantity 3 and overstock 6. Exact-int validation and zero removal were inspected but not exercised through HTTP.
risks.next_probe: On the assigned runtime, reproduce -1 first with before/after reads and restoration; check missing, null, string, boolean, fractional quantities and boundaries 0/1/5/6, with zero last on a resettable fixture.

risks.reason: Both routes authenticate through fixed fixture tokens and use the actor's cart; no runtime isolation or rejection evidence is available.
risks.next_probe: Compare Alice and Bob before/after independent updates; exercise anonymous and invalid-token product/cart GET and item PUT, verifying unchanged carts.

risks.reason: The fixture has stock 5 and price 12; stock rejection precedes mutation and updates do not decrement stock, based on source only.
risks.next_probe: Verify quantity 5 succeeds with price 60, quantity 6 returns 409 without mutation, and catalog stock remains 5 across both callers' changes.

risks.area: Price consistency under future catalog changes
risks.reason: Cart totals use literal 12 rather than the catalog price. Current fixture price is also 12, so no current discrepancy is established.
risks.next_probe: If supported product-price changes enter scope, compare catalog unit price with cart totals after such a change.

risks.area: Adjacent UI feedback and asynchronous refresh
risks.reason: UI source was inspected only; refresh has no failure catch and no stale-response guard. Keyboard, layout, and delayed-response behavior were not observed.
risks.next_probe: When the runtime is available, verify Save/Cancel and keyboard flow at desktop/narrow widths, then test failed and delayed refreshes with Alice/Bob switching.

limitations: The assigned runtime was unavailable and was not started. All findings are source-derived, not HTTP-confirmed.
Existing tests were inspected but not executed; no application execution was performed.
Zero API requests and zero browser actions; no UI screenshots or visual observations.
Concurrency and transport behavior remain unverified; no out-of-scope checkout, item adding, or production-authentication assessment.
cleanup: No fixture/cart or application changes occurred. Only report.md, submission.json and evidence files were created; no runtime or browser session was started.
